findings.title: PodDisruptionBudget allows no disruptions
findings.cause: PodDisruptionBudget web allows 0 disruptions with all 1 of its pods healthy (minAvailable 1), so evicting any of them, as a node drain or cluster upgrade does, waits forever

evidence.command: kubectl get pdb web -n kd-pdb-blocks-drain -o jsonpath='{.spec}{"\n"}{.status}'

findings.fix: Allow at least one disruption: lower minAvailable below the replica count, set maxUnavailable to 1 or more, or run more replicas.
